deadEnd.details: Big Cartel store whose only gateway is PayPal — no card fields ever mount, so the checkout is classified paypal-only before the wizard's payment step. Live-classified by the bench on 2026-07-20 (level `detect`).

notes: Counter-example to sanjosestickers.bigcartel.com: Big Cartel itself supports Stripe, so the dead-end is this store's gateway choice, not the platform's.
